text: i2cdetect shows the device present, and the Adafruit default address matches it, so the address is not the bug. The controller still cannot address the part because SDA and SCL are swapped in the wiring (I2C(scl, sda) versus the board's SCL=GPIO3, SDA=GPIO2). This is a wiring fault. STOP coding; rewire SDA/SCL to the correct pins and confirm the pull-ups before retrying.
